theorem_title: Propagation of the mechanical envelope by twelve steps
natural_language_statement:
For $s\in\mathbb N$, define $M(0)=0$, $M(s+1)=3M(s)+2^{\lfloor\log_2(3^s)\rfloor}$, and $e(s)=\lfloor\log_2(3^s)\rfloor+1$.

Let $s\in\mathbb N$ and assume $4M(s)\le s3^s$. Then

$$
4M(s+12)\le(s+12)3^{s+12}.
$$

A finite set of consecutive base cases can therefore cover every later index by residue modulo 12.
